title: Sensei Dashboard Workspace Architect Session V1
description: A Dashboard/runner-owned record of one persistent primary-architect conversation thread (docs/architecture-workspace-v1.md §5, docs/claude-workspace-o1-brief.md §2). Mutable local orchestration state -- not architectural truth, not part of dashboard-projection-v1, and never a claim that this session is the same stored thread as an ordinary browser chat conversation.
$comment: schema_version is a const: any field addition, removal, rename, or semantic change requires a new schema identifier/version. This contract is Dashboard/runner-owned per claude-workspace-o1-brief.md §11.1/§A -- it does not define Sensei admission truth, it only records what a governed session was told at admission time (governing_snapshot/admission_reference), citing Sensei's real ClaimDocumentBinding/admission.Decision shapes (globulario/sensei golang/architecture/claim_document.go, golang/architecture/admission/admission.go) rather than a byte-pinned Sensei wire format, since no canonical JSON Schema for those Go types exists yet (see docs/architecture-workspace-contracts-v1.md).

architect_runtime.$comment: thread_id/resumable describe the embedded runtime's own continuity primitives only (e.g. codex app-server thread ids) -- never a claim of identity with an ordinary browser ChatGPT conversation (architecture-workspace-v1.md §5).

updated_at.$comment: Recorded evidence timestamps only -- never ordering/causal authority over other records (claude-workspace-o1-brief.md §2).

continuity_refs.$comment: Bounded references into durable project state (Sensei decisions, GitHub issues/PRs/comments) the architect uses to reconstruct continuity -- never a raw chat transcript (architecture-workspace-v1.md §5).

allOf.$comment: Law F, governed half: a governed record must bind a real admission_reference.
Law F, manual half: a manual record must not fabricate an admission_reference -- forced null, not merely unconstrained. Manual and governed stay structurally distinct.

assuranceMode.$comment: A manual (CLI/editor-direct) session must never be structurally indistinguishable from an admission-gated governed run (claude-workspace-o1-brief.md Law F).

governingSnapshot.$comment: Dashboard-owned snake_case encoding of Sensei's real ClaimDocumentBinding (globulario/sensei golang/architecture/claim_document.go:27-34) -- the exact binding a governed job's admission was evaluated against, snapshotted at admission time so the job's own later edits to docs/awareness/**/.sensei/config.yaml cannot change the policy identity it is held to (Law G).

admissionReference.$comment: Mirrors Sensei's real admission.Decision identity fields (globulario/sensei golang/architecture/admission/admission.go:226-256) -- a reference to a decision Sensei made, not a Dashboard-invented admission authority.
